string-array.item: Subtitles from the internet: search from the player in OpenSubtitles, Wizdom (Hebrew), YIFY Subtitles and Addic7ed, free and without an account.
Found even for files whose names say nothing. Optional: your own OpenSubtitles.com key and an automatic search, in Settings › Subtitles.
Live TV: the info bar fits a phone held upright.
Android TV: the remote reaches every video and every button of the player.
